title: What the Budget Billing (Levelized and Equal Payment Plans) Installment Covers
content:
# What the Budget Billing (Levelized and Equal Payment Plans) Installment Covers

On Budget Billing (Levelized and Equal Payment Plans), some charges on a member's bill are leveled into the installment and some are billed on top of it. This page sets out, for every plan, which kinds of charges are leveled, whether the bill shows the actual charges and the deferred balance, and the interest rate on the deferred balance.

## Coverage by plan

| Plan | Power cost adjustment leveled | Sales tax leveled | Program charges (arrangement installments, light rentals) leveled | Fees and late charges leveled | Every bill shows actual charges and deferred balance | Interest on the deferred balance, percent per year |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Levelized Billing Rolling Average | Yes | Yes | No | No | Yes | 0.00 |
| Budget Billing Annual Settle-Up | Yes | Yes | No | No | Yes | 0.00 |
| Budget Billing Quarterly Review | Yes | Yes | No | No | Yes | 0.00 |
| Farm Budget Billing | Yes | Yes | No | No | Yes | 0.00 |
| Small Business Budget Billing | Yes | Yes | No | No | Yes | 0.00 |
| Ten-Month Equal Payment Plan | Yes | Yes | No | No | Yes | 0.00 |

## In plain terms

All six plans treat charges the same way:

- **Leveled into the installment:** the usage lines of the bill, together with the power cost adjustment and sales tax.
- **Not leveled, billed in addition:** program charges, such as payment arrangement installments and security light rentals, and fees and late charges.
- **On the statement:** every bill shows the actual charges and the deferred balance.
- **Interest:** the interest rate on the deferred balance is 0.00 percent per year on every plan.

## A hypothetical bill

*Hypothetical figures only.* A member on Budget Billing Annual Settle-Up has an installment of $128.00. In one month the bill also carries a $9.50 light rental and a $4.00 fee. Neither is leveled, so both are billed in addition to the $128.00. The usage lines, power cost adjustment and sales tax for the month are all leveled, so they are not billed separately; the bill shows them as the actual charges, along with the deferred balance.
